title: The Unsolved Mystery of the Zodiac Killer

scenes.text: Between 1968 and 1969, a serial killer known as the Zodiac struck terror in California.
The Zodiac sent taunting letters to the press, boasting about his crimes.
Over 50 years later, the case remains open and unsolved.
The surprising twist? The identity of the Zodiac Killer is still unknown.
Follow for daily true crime mysteries.

description: The Zodiac Killer terrifies San Francisco in the late 1960s, leaving behind a legacy of unanswered questions. Can we still find him? #shorts #truecrime #coldcase #ZodiacKiller #mystery #fyp
